system.description:
Kishai Inheritance: a traded good. Very Rare, Air. 1 item slot.

Prerequisites: Training: Military Weapons

A large bamboo tube-like shape, with a series of airholes to blow through. It looks all the world like a woodwind instrument, if for its much more dramatic effect.

Grass Cannon (Action): Treat this weapon as a crossbow, except it deals magic damage (Air Element) in a 15ft cone emanating from you, rather than against a single target up to 120ft away. If you apply a Trick Strike or other effect to this cannon, the effect is applied to all creatures within the cone. If any roll you make in your to-hit with this weapon is a natural 1, the weapon misfires, and has no effect, even if it would critically hit (e.g., if you roll 3X advantage and roll a 6, 12, 20, and 1, the weapon will misfire).

Rulebook p.74.
